what_this_is: Attacks on the Phase 18 API surface, run against the live Docker stack with hand-built requests. The frontend is not involved in any of them, which is the point: the browser is untrusted, so the only question is what the API does when the caller does not cooperate.

method.control_plane: from the host against the published control-plane port
method.gateway: from a throwaway container on aegis_agent_net, the only network that can reach the gateway
method.tenants: two real organizations created through the product, each with its own operator and agents

not_covered: Denial of service and rate limiting were not tested.
The browser session itself (XSS, CSRF, token storage) was not tested here.
These are point-in-time observations of one deployment, not a proof about all deployments.

control_plane.attack: read another tenant's agent by id
queue a runtime job on another tenant's agent
unauthenticated POST of a verification run
agent credential used as an operator session
control_plane.observed: 403 {'detail': 'Agent credentials cannot access the control plane'}

control_plane.expected: ignored; the contract binds to the caller's own agent, not the one named in the body

control_plane.attack: smuggled contract appears on the victim's agent
hostile agent id "'; DROP TABLE agents;--"
agent job channel exposed on the public control plane

gateway.attack: unauthenticated claim of a queued job
another tenant's agent claims a job queued for the victim
gateway.expected: no job, or only its own

gateway.attack: forge a PASS verdict on another agent's run
operator session used as an agent credential
control-plane route /api/agents usable on the gateway
gateway.expected: refused both anonymously and with an agent credential

gateway.attack: control-plane route /api/approvals usable on the gateway
gateway.expected: refused both anonymously and with an agent credential

gateway.attack: control-plane route /api/auth/login usable on the gateway
gateway.expected: refused both anonymously and with an agent credential

gateway.attack: operator login served by the enforcement gateway
gateway.expected: 404; the route is not in this role
